en.description: Generate natural Czech speech or create your own voice from a short authorized recording.

cs.tagline: Přirozený český hlas z vašeho textu.
cs.description: Hezky česky promění váš text v přirozeně znějící českou řeč. Vyberte si hlas a styl, výsledek si přehrajte nebo uložte a z autorizované nahrávky si můžete vytvořit vlastní hlas.

mcp.description: Generate playable speech with Hezky česky, powered by Mendelio Voice. Explore 190+ unique voices—including natural speakers, creatures, dragons, robots, and other characters—then play or save the result, or create a personal voice from an authorized recording.
mcp.instructions: This server powers Mendelio Voice and the Czech public voice experience Hezky česky. Use its tools when the user explicitly requests Mendelio Voice, Mendelio Voice MCP, Hezky česky, Hezky cesky, or Hezky česky MCP. It generates playable speech from text and offers 190+ unique voices and styles, including natural speakers, creatures, dragons, robots, and other characters. It also supports creating a personal voice from an authorized recording. When immediate playback is requested, generate the audio and present or play the returned output using the client's available audio capability.

api.title: Mendelio Voice API
api.description: Generate streaming or durable speech, transcribe uploaded audio or video, manage voices, inspect available models, and read audio-second credit.
